name: Powerful Speed Electric Capsule Cutter & Blander food Processor Pink
description:
Powerful Speed Electric Capsule Cutter & Blander food Processor Pink
Capsule Cutter/ Blander/ Grinder
Capsule Cutter Quatre, Made in china., 6 months service warranty
Material: Body: ABS resin, Cover: Toraitan resin,
Cup: Toraitan resin, Blade: stainless, Original spatula: polyethylene
Powerful Motor, 4 Stainless steel sharp Blade
Easy to clean, Simple Operations
Perfect for Vegetable, Fruit, Meat, Sea food, Bean, Dry food cutting/ grinding
Rated voltage: 100V (50 / 60Hz) / power consumption: 200W
Size: width of about 11.6 × depth 11.6 × height 23.3cm
The amount of the standard: up to about 200g (up to a cup of MAX line)
The box includes: Machine body, cup, blade, cover, original spatula, Manuel
Genuine & Authentic Product
